_comment: Three hooks, one command, no shell scripts.
This file used to be one of fourteen near-identical hooks.<agent>.json variants
wiring fifteen bash scripts, and the scripts reimplemented in ~2,000 lines of
shell what the CLI already does in Go: manifest parsing, install-command
matching, secret detection. `vulnetix agent hook` reads the host's payload on
stdin and writes the host's response on stdout, so one command serves every
agent, and it runs on native Windows, which the bash hooks never did.
The other thirteen variants are gone because they are no longer hand-written:
`vulnetix agent install` detects the agents on a machine and writes each one's
config in its own dialect. This file remains for Claude Code marketplace
installs, where the plugin ships its own hooks.
No ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} anywhere. That variable is set only by Claude Code, and
only for plugin-loaded content, which is why 31 of the 33 skills silently
returned nothing on every other agent.
PreToolUse carries a matcher because it has a tool to match. SessionStart and
UserPromptSubmit carry none: they have no tool name, so a matcher there
registers a hook that can never fire.
